comparison.objective: Flatten a spring-creased open carton for recycling.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply a steep, sustained pushing trajectory through a folding arc until the creases set.
comparison.success_condition: Carton shear reaches at least 80 degrees, lies below 2.5 cm, is still and released; partial folding or spring-back fails.
comparison.reason: Crease collapse and flattening do not exercise tool alignment, lock preservation, tuning, or controlled axial stopping.
